player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} aakar {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors khelnaame.
Tomar lakshya sabse beshi round jite.
Pratyek roundme, '[rock]', '[paper]', ba '[scissors]' madhye ekta jawab dao.
Tomar '[r]', '[p]', ba '[s]' shorthand hisabeo babohar korte paro.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ᱢᱩᱵᱽ ᱢᱟᱱᱟᱜ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱧᱮᱞᱚᱜ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ. [rock], [paper], ᱟᱨᱵᱟᱝ [scissors] ᱵᱮᱵᱷᱟᱨᱤᱠᱟ.

outcome.p1_wins: ᱠᱷᱮᱞᱚᱸᱰᱤᱭᱟᱹ ᱑ ᱡᱚᱛᱚ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱵᱟᱹᱲᱛᱤ ᱨᱟᱱ ᱮ ᱦᱟᱛᱟᱣ ᱠᱮᱫ-ᱟ!
